    m.addConstr(6.54 * vars['Var_0'] + -5.67 * vars['Var_1'] + 2.65 * vars['Var_3'] + -9.23 * vars['Var_4'] + -0.32 * vars['Var_5'] <= 24.44, name='C2')
    m.addConstr(-8.21 * vars['Var_1'] + -0.08 * vars['Var_3'] + -4.74 * vars['Var_5'] <= -30.82, name='C3')
    m.addConstr(6.45 * vars['Var_1'] + 6.31 * vars['Var_2'] + -2.42 * vars['Var_3'] + 6.53 * vars['Var_4'] + -1.08 * vars['Var_5'] <= 51.23, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(-7.42 * vars['Var_1'] + 4.23 * vars['Var_3'] + -0.38 * vars['Var_4'] <= 16.62, name='C5')
    m.addConstr(-9.67 * vars['Var_0'] + -5.92 * vars['Var_1'] + 4.26 * vars['Var_2'] + -1.38 * vars['Var_3'] + 4.58 * vars['Var_4'] + -5.26 * vars['Var_5'] <= -29.06, name='C6')
